sentences.en: The development of human sexuality starts at an early age.
sentences.zh: 人类性意识的发展始于很小的时候。

sentences.en: Our talk about the sexuality of flies could offend some people.
sentences.zh: 我们关于果蝇性行为的讨论可能会冒犯一些人。

sentences.en: You shouldn't associate sexuality with poverty. It isn't Roman.
sentences.zh: 你不应该把性与贫穷联系在一起。这毫无根据。

senses.zh: [胚] 性别；性欲；性征；性方面的事情（比如性行为或性能力）
